title: Reply to new leads instantly
blurb: Text and email every new enquiry within seconds, and ping your team.

steps.title: Open Automation
steps.body: The first business to reply usually wins the job. Click **Automation** in the left menu.

steps.title: Start a new workflow
steps.body: Click **Create Workflow** and start from scratch. At the top, rename it to something you will recognise later, like "New lead reply".

steps.title: Choose what starts it
steps.body: Click **Add New Trigger** and pick **Form Submitted**. Add a filter so it only fires for your enquiry form.
steps.tip: Leads from Facebook? Add a second trigger for your Facebook lead form.

steps.title: Send a text
steps.body: Click **+** under the trigger and choose **Send SMS**. Keep it short and personal, and use the first name field so it reads like you wrote it.

steps.title: Send an email
steps.body: Click **+** again and add **Send Email** with a bit more detail: what happens next and how to book.

steps.title: Tell your team
steps.body: Add **Send Internal Notification** so you get a text or email with the lead's details straight away.

steps.title: Save, test and publish
steps.body: Click **Save**. Run **Test Workflow** on your own contact, then switch **Draft** to **Publish** and save again.
steps.tip: Nothing is sent until the workflow is published.
